scientific_integrity: All numerical and lattice invariants of the two explicit equations are exactly proved/checked; no claim of independent verification or absolute literature uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: The nonsplit F5 model is not asserted to be the actual F5 descent of the exceptional cubic in the source resolution; only its F25 base change occurs there. Older line-table priority is not exhaustively resolved; full automorphism groups and arithmetic Brauer groups are not determined. Exact checks were same-model; independent validation is absent.
title: Arithmetic descent of two characteristic-five cubic exceptional models
